title: Gideon and the Radiators
author: Bram Underhill
blurb: Tamsin Brightwater, an heir cataloging a parent's silence after the funeral, moves through the days like a tenant, not an owner. But when a song on the radio is one that was written and never recorded, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, she must translate the untranslatable sentence and live with it before the house sale closes.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
